_about.role: Single Source of Truth connecting stories in your narrative universe to their scenes and continuity cards.
_about.why: Instead of hardcoding paths in multiple scripts, this one master file tells your tools exactly where to find each story's scene records and wardrobe continuity cards.
_about.how: Add your story under 'stories' with its id, scenes_file, and continuity_file. Run `npm run verify` to test all stories.
